# Synthetic Fall-Risk Observation Workflow

## Scenario Setup
This generated fixture models a training room checklist for simulated mobility observation. It contains no real case details and no authoritative clinical content.

## Observation Group
1. Check whether the scenario card says the walking path is clear.
2. Observe whether the training actor pauses before changing direction.
3. Record synthetic balance cues only from the scripted exercise.
4. Keep the note bounded to the exercise and request human review for any uncertainty.

## Row Group
| cue | generated note |
| path | clear or cluttered according to the script |
| pause | present or absent according to the script |
| review | required for all sandbox retrieval demonstrations |

## Safety Boundary
This text is for deterministic chunking and lexical search tests only. It must remain synthetic-only and non-authoritative.
